summary: Commit 867569c meets the frozen spec and REV-0001 conditions: ls-tree --full-tree --name-only <commit> .ai/tasks/ with exact basename matching, GIT_TASK_REFS_UNAVAILABLE on failure, collection before the first mkdir, keyword-only default keeps callers. Tests fail if the branch scan or the ordering is removed. V1 evidence passed (2290 passed, 628 s, coverage 89%, diff coverage 100%).

findings.title: Parallel worktrees with uncommitted task directories can still allocate the same ID; branch refs see only committed task dirs
Failure-ordering integration test monkeypatches the collector; real git failure covered by unit test
A branch ref pointing at a non-commit blocks start (fails safe, no ref-specific diagnostic)
